decision_rule: Evaluate CTO and TIM independently. Return 1 when the paper's central research question or substantive contribution falls within that community's AOM domain statement. Return 0 when the connection is incidental, based only on a keyword, or unsupported by the title and abstract. A paper may receive 1 for both communities or 0 for both. Do not infer a community from the journal, authors, or benchmark membership alone.

CTO.name: Communication, Digital Technology, and Organization
CTO.scope: Behavioral, social, and economic processes at the intersection of communication, digital technology, information systems, and organizing within or among organizations or institutions. This includes technology-enabled work and collaboration, digital platforms and communities, digital transformation, platform governance, IT diffusion, organizational change and design, and AI when these are studied as organizational or communication phenomena.

TIM.name: Technology and Innovation Management
TIM.scope: The management, antecedents, mechanisms, and implications of innovation and technological change. This includes technology strategy, invention, R&D, knowledge and intellectual property, open and user innovation, technology entrepreneurship, commercialization and scaling, technological systems and ecosystems, and emerging technologies when linked substantively to innovation or technological change.
